name: How does the Colorado climate impact garage door choices?

mainEntity.name: How does the Colorado climate impact garage door choices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Colorado weather brings heavy snowfall, rapid temperature drops, hail, and high wind gusts that put extreme demands on garage door components. In communities like Aurora, Centennial, and Parker, standard single-layer doors can warp or dent easily during severe hail storms. Cold snaps can also stress metal springs and track seals. Selecting high-impact steel, heavy-duty weatherstripping, and high R-value insulation protects against freeze-thaw cycles and shields your vehicles, tools, and finished interior spaces from draft intrusion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Colorado's freeze-thaw cycles, winter snow, and summer hail require impact-resistant panels, durable bottom seals, and thermal insulation to keep garages protected and energy-efficient.
